Power values may be '*' or NULL for unknown/infinite power, so numeric comparisons must handle both.
Foil availability requires both cl0094 and cl0095 to be non-null; checking only one overcounts.
Transaction dates are stored as YYYYMM strings, so year/month filters must use string prefixes.
Country codes are ISO3 ('CZE','SVK'), not full country names.
Translation names may be NULL when no translation exists; filter cl0182 IS NOT NULL.
Driver full name is split across cl0255 (forename) and cl0256 (surname); must concatenate to match names like 'Lewis Hamilton'
Race year and date are separate columns; 'since 2010' should use cl0258 not cl0261
Circuit coordinates are split into latitude cl0244 and longitude cl0245; both needed for location
Expense date cl0314 is stored as string; month extraction needs substring/parsing
Accident count uses cl0279 = 3 as the accident indicator; other values are not accidents
Qualifying Q1 time cl0276 may be NULL for drivers who did not participate in Q1
Client gender values are 'F'/'M'; other encodings may exist and should be checked
Loan amount cl0235 is also used as transaction type code in tb022; join carefully to avoid ambiguity
Event status values may be stored with different casing/spacing so 'Closed' filter can miss rows
Superhero attribute names may vary in case (Strength vs strength) causing equality filters to miss rows
